title: Sequence context and focus-only D3 exploration
description:
Implement configurable sequence context and focus-only D3 node activation after owner scope gate.

Authoritative contract: U is all eligible files after Denote exclusions, explore ignore regexp and text-only policy; S is selected structural sequence; H is sequence parentage; L is actual directed Denote links supported by current extractor within U. V0=S; each next V adds either endpoint of L touching prior V. Depth 0 exports S+H only. Positive depth exports Vd, H and every actual link whose endpoints lie in Vd. Every S node seeds depth zero; incoming/outgoing traversal preserves original direction and repeated occurrence weights. Separate hierarchy and actual relations sharing endpoints. Every endpoint must resolve.

Sequence identity is persistent and separate from temporary selectedNodeId. All D3 node activation pans/highlights direct exported connections without navigation, graph mutation or fresh neighborhood loading. Keep file colors, hero labels, typed paths, accessible keyboard/clear/status, reduced motion and ordinary drag/pan. Backward-compatible options, other graph types and static topology export are mandatory.

Owner-confirmed: configurable external depth, sequence focal group, click pan/highlight not rearrangement, no note-opening on node click. Recommended defaults require child 01 approval. No browser depth slider, live Emacs bridge/fetching, strict tree layout, broad sidebar rewrite or dynamic focus for static exports.

Original plan and supporting notes: .agents/plans/20260909T160842--sequence-context-node-focus__planned/plan.md (browser-feasibility.md is historical; its fixed-one-hop suggestion is superseded by configurable depth in plan.md). Plan folders are ignored for new artifacts, so issues carry execution instructions directly. This epic is a roll-up, not a runnable implementation task; keep open until every child and final acceptance complete.

title: SCF-11: Implement indexed eligible-universe context traversal
description:
Plan work item 11 of 30. Role: implementer.

Add focused helpers in denote-explore.el. Compute U once from Denote directory exclusions, text-only policy and explore ignore regexp. Build exact ID→file and adjacency indexes. At positive depth call --network-extract-edges once for eligible note sources, prune both endpoints to U, and BFS undirected reachability from every S member at distance zero while retaining original edge direction separately. Track visited/frontier and minimum contextDistance, terminate on exhaustion, no substring ID matching. Depth 0 skips body scanning. Preserve raw extracted occurrences for later aggregation; if real-extractor tests reveal same-line occurrences lost by xref summaries, STOP and ask main agent to choose a sequence-local occurrence-preserving extraction path or explicitly authorize a shared-extractor behavior change. Shared extraction changes require new cross-graph failing regression tests, updated baseline expectations and owner-approved scope before resuming; do not silently modify Community/Neighbourhood semantics. Do not broaden supported link syntax. Do not use --network-unique-edges or repeat single-note neighbourhood traversal. Apply duplicate-ID failure policy rather than silently merging ambiguous files.
